roles.acting_for: The holder an acting or interim holder stands in for.
roles.acts_on: What an action works on, the thing it checks, loads, sends, changes or creates.
roles.answers: An open question (a Gap) that the statement answers.
roles.answers_to: Whom a party answers to for a responsibility.
roles.attribute: The attribute a statement describes, when no standard attribute fits.
roles.base: The table a measure aggregates over.
roles.because: An element the statement's reason names.
roles.belongs_to: The thing a state or event concept is of.
roles.binds: Who must comply with a rule.
roles.by: The party, tool or system that carries out an action.
roles.calendar: The calendar a metric's grains, windows and offsets follow.
roles.cases: An element a calculation's cases name.
roles.causes: The effect an influence has; in an Indicates, an element its conditions name.
roles.consumes: What a procedure step takes in.
roles.contains: The field, concept or entity a table or dataset holds information about.
roles.correlates_with: The measure another moves together with.
roles.decided_in: Where it was decided or recorded (a meeting, a channel, a ticket, a document).
roles.derived_from: What a table, report or other element is built or sourced from.
roles.described_in: The document, page or section that describes an element.
roles.divided_by: The field or dimension that divides a group into its members.
roles.endorsed_by: Who agreed with or supported it.
roles.entity: The kind of thing a conversion metric follows from its first event to its second.
roles.escalates_to: The party, team or channel a problem goes to next.
roles.governed_by: The law, policy, agreement or document that governs an element.
roles.has: A part or attribute an element has.
roles.has_access: What a party may reach or use.
roles.heads: The unit, team or organization a party heads.
roles.held_by: Whose preference, view or wish it is.
roles.holds_role: The role or post a party holds.
roles.implemented_by: The field, table or other data element that holds or computes a concept.
roles.inputs: The tables, fields, metrics and joins a calculation or job uses.
roles.is_a: The category an element is put in.
roles.items: An element of a list, sequence or group.
roles.joins_to: The table or dataset another joins to.
roles.key_pairs: The fields a join matches on.
roles.maps_to: What a value, code or element maps to.
roles.member_of: The unit, team or group a party belongs to.
roles.members: The elements that together make up or identify one row or group.
roles.non_additive: The elements a non-additive value is kept for, one each (the last balance for each account).
roles.object: The second element a statement is about.
roles.options_in_order: The options an action takes, in order of preference.
roles.outputs: What a job, procedure or calculation produces (columns, sections).
roles.overlaps: An element whose meaning or scope overlaps another's.
roles.overrides: A statement this one takes precedence over.
roles.part_of: The whole an element is part of.
roles.performer: Who does a habit, step or activity.
roles.period: The period a statement or value covers.
roles.produces: What a statement brings about, the state a change reaches or what an action creates.
roles.property_value: An element a property's value names.
roles.ratified_in: Where it was ratified (a meeting, a council, a document).
roles.reacts_to: What a statement responds to, an element its condition names.
roles.reports_to: Whom a party or post reports to.
roles.role: The role an element plays through a join or an action (buyer, recipient).
roles.routes_to: Where an action sends something, or the channel, tool or intermediary it goes through.
roles.scope: The elements a statement is limited to.
roles.share: An element a share or proportion names.
roles.so_that: An element the statement's purpose names.
roles.state_input: What a change of state depends on, what changes, the state it leaves, what its conditions test.
roles.subject: What the statement is about, the party that acts, the job that runs, the cause.
roles.time_dimension: The time column a measure is counted by.
roles.unit_from: The column that holds the unit or currency of a value, row by row (added in 1.3).
roles.used_for: The activity or question type an element serves.
roles.values: An element a statement's values name (a unit, the event a duration is counted from).
roles.via: The channel, tool or intermediary something goes through.
roles.within: An element a time limit names or is counted from.
roles.works_with: The party another coordinates or works closely with.
roles.written_by: The job that writes a table, view or data container.
